blind.description: A stylized fantasy sea shrine or idol featuring a prominent three-pronged trident set into a circular plinth base. Sculpted, swirling ocean waves with foamy white crests curl up and around the trident. The base is decorated with shell and aquatic swirl motifs. Materials and colors consist of deep teal and aqua-blue water with opaque white sea foam, and an off-white or pale stone/silver finish on the trident and plinth with teal gemstone/inlay accents. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and stylized with clean hand-painted style textures.
blind.from_above: A top-down view showing the horizontal profile of the trident's three prongs at the center, flanked by curling white sea-foam crests and teal water, sitting atop the circular perimeter of the stone base.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly two-thirds the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 3.8 to 4 feet tall), and about 2.5 feet wide across the circular base.
